categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes signing and PSBT analysis logic in `src/script/sign.cpp`; RPC merely exposes the PSBT analysis behavior without modifying RPC machinery.
categories.rationale: Not an RPC category change. The category covers node programmatic interfaces and excludes behavior that an RPC merely exposes.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled PSBT, modifies PSBT signing logic in `src/script/sign.cpp`, and directly affects wallet GUI role analysis and `wallet_musig` tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes incorrect role classification and misleading input-information warnings during PSBT analysis. `AnalyzePSBT()` failed to detect missing Taproot script-path signatures, classifying the next role as `updater` instead of `signer` and causing the wallet GUI to display an inaccurate warning that the transaction was 'missing some information about inputs'.
